name: Styloforge Font Style Generator
author: jhon990

sections.description:
Create stylish text instantly with schriftartengeneratorr and make your social media profiles, bios, and messages stand out. Use schriftartengeneratorr to generate unique fonts quickly, easily, and for free.

Great for Instagram bios, TikTok, WhatsApp statuses and Discord names.

Shortcode:

[styfrg_font_generator]

Note: Heading, description, button text and placeholder text can all be edited
under “Settings -> Styloforge Font Generator” right from the WordPress admin –
no code editing required. This means there is no risk of accidentally disabling
the plugin just by changing text.

Features

  • Live conversion directly in the browser (no server request needed)
  • One-click copy per style
  • Editable text via the settings screen
  • Lightweight and performant: scripts only load when the shortcode is
    actually used on the page
  • No external service, no data transfer – everything runs locally in the browser
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP file via “Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin”.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Optionally customize the text under “Settings -> Styloforge Font Generator”.
  4. Add the shortcode [styfrg_font_generator] to any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple generators with different text?

Yes. The shortcode accepts optional attributes, for example:
[styfrg_font_generator heading=”My Title” description=”My description”]

Does this install real fonts?

No, it uses Unicode characters that work on every device without installation.
